title: Shaping Voices: Mirage Audio
description: Launch of mirage audio — a 10B text+audio-to-audio model that generates expressive vocal performances, enables voice design and cloning, and powers cross-language voice transformation.

title: Seeing Voices: Generating A-Roll Video from Audio with Mirage
description: Our paper on mirage video — a 13B audio-conditioned model that generates fully synchronized A-roll: speaker, lips, expressions, and gestures from audio alone. arXiv:2506.08279.

title: How to Fine-Tune Very Large Model if It Doesn't Fit on Your GPU
description: A practical guide to training models that exceed single-GPU memory: gradient checkpointing, mixed precision, ZeRO, offloading, and sharded data parallelism. 600+ reactions on Medium.
